project_not_found_body: This project does not exist or its link is invalid.
import_error_too_large: The file is too large to import (maximum 5 MB).
import_error_invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
import_error_not_a_project: The file is not a NAND project file.
import_error_unsupported_version: Project file version {version} is not supported.
import_error_future_version: This project was saved by a newer version of the app (file version {version}, supported {supported}).
import_error_invalid_project: The project file is damaged or invalid.
persistence_error_not_found: That project was not found in this browser.
persistence_error_corrupt: The saved project is damaged and could not be opened. {reason}
persistence_error_quota: Browser storage is full, so the project could not be saved.
persistence_error_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Your work is kept in memory only and will be lost when you close this tab.
editor_error_chip_not_saved: Save this chip before placing it in another chip.
editor_error_would_contain_itself: A chip can't contain itself, directly or through another chip.
editor_error_invalid_endpoint: That pin does not exist on this chip.
editor_error_bit_out_of_range: Bit {bit} does not exist on a {width}-bit pin.
editor_error_width_mismatch: A {from}-bit pin can't be wired to a {to}-bit pin.
editor_error_output_to_output: Two outputs can't be wired together.
editor_error_input_to_input: Wire an output to an input; two inputs can't be joined.
editor_error_input_already_driven: That input already has a wire.
editor_error_pin_index_out_of_range: Position {index} is outside the pin list.
editor_error_invalid_color: {color} is not a colour in #rrggbb form.
projects_empty: No projects yet. Create one to start.
project_corrupt_title: This project could not be opened
netlist_error_chip_not_found: This circuit uses a chip that is missing from the project.
netlist_error_chip_not_saved: This circuit uses a chip that has never been saved.
netlist_error_recursive_chip: A chip contains itself, so the circuit cannot be simulated.
netlist_error_wire_loop: Wires form a loop that no gate drives, so the circuit cannot be simulated.
netlist_error_unconnected_pin: A chip has an unconnected input, so the circuit cannot be simulated. Connect it or undo the change.
netlist_error_invalid_wire: A wire connects two pins that cannot be joined, so the circuit cannot be simulated.
engine_error_signal_out_of_range: The simulator rejected the circuit because a signal points outside it.
engine_error_bad_message: The simulator received a request it could not understand.
engine_error_worker_failed: The simulator stopped working. Reload the page to try again.
update_ready: A new version of the app is ready.
canvas_hint: Press ] and [ to select chips, arrow keys to move them, Delete to remove them, P to hear their pins and Enter for the chip menu.
